items.title: Steelers WRs Michael Pittman, Roman Wilson return to practice
items.text: The Steelers are opening the practice window for several players on Wednesday.

items.title: Kenneth Walker won't practice Wednesday with groin injury
items.text: Kenneth Walker's groin injury will keep him out for at least another day.

items.title: D.J. Reed returns to Lions practice
items.text: The Lions have gotten plenty of bad injury news on defense in recent weeks, but there was a positive development at practice on Wednesday.

items.title: Dolphins sign Max Llewellyn from practice squad, sign Jack Browning to practice squad
items.text: The Dolphins signed edge rusher Max Llewellyn to the active roster from the practice squad. the team announced Wednesday.

items.title: David Montgomery has no injury designation for Thursday; Woody Marks ruled out
items.text: The Texans ruled one running back out for Thursday night's game against the Colts, but they're set to get another one back in the lineup.

items.title: Vikings won't put Jordan Addison on IR
items.text: When Vikings head coach Kevin O'Connell announced that wide receiver Jordan Addison needed thumb surgery earlier this week, he said that an injured reserve stint was a possibility.

items.title: Brian Schottenheimer: Christian Parker still has a bright future with the Cowboys
items.text: Brian Schottenheimer confirmed Mike Pettine will take over as the Cowboys' defensive play-caller on Sunday.

items.title: After earning their first win, Chargers are favored to win their second vs. Jets
items.text: The Chargers finally won a game on Monday.

items.title: Darren Waller, Tommy Tremble out of practice for Panthers
items.text: The Panthers practiced without their top two tight ends on Wednesday.

items.title: Sean Mannion to continue calling offensive plays for Eagles, Joe Milton to remain at QB
items.text: Eagles head coach Nick Sirianni said that the team would talk about changes to roles and responsibilities on the coaching staff during their bye week, but he said on Wednesday that they decided against any major ones.

items.title: Todd Bowles: Baker Mayfield's made progress, decision on playing to come on Friday
items.text: Buccaneers quarterback Baker Mayfield missed practice on Wednesday with a foot injury, but the team hasn't made a decision on his availability for Sunday's game against the Lions.

items.title: Vikings sign WR Jeshaun Jones to active roster
items.text: The Vikings will be without Jordan Addison for the coming weeks because of a thumb injury and they added another wide receiver to their active roster on Wednesday.

items.title: Sauce Gardner questionable, Charvarius Ward ruled out for Thursday vs. Texans
items.text: The Colts may be particularly thin in the secondary for Thursday night's game against the Texans.

items.title: When the season expands to 18 games, reseeding will likely follow
items.text: Division champs would lose the automatic wild-card home game.

items.title: The early reviews for the Madden movie aren't good
items.text: The Madden movie, starring Nicolas Cage as the legendary coach, broadcaster, and video-game mogul, has landed on Prime Video.

items.title: Wan'Dale Robinson out for season with ankle injury
items.text: The Titans will not have one of their key receivers for the rest of 2026.

items.title: Todd Monken: Getting flexed into Sunday night is really cool for our players
items.text: If someone had told you at the beginning of the season that the Week 12 game between the Browns and Raiders would get flexed into Sunday Night Football, you probably would have responded with some healthy skepticism.

items.title: No practice for Baker Mayfield on Wednesday
items.text: Word on Tuesday was that Buccaneers quarterback Baker Mayfield's outlook for this week's game against the Lions was not promising and Wednesday didn't bring any better news.

items.title: Tory Horton's heads up play earns him NFC special teams player of the week
items.text: Late in Sunday's victory over the Raiders, Seahawks receiver Tory Horton made a heads-up play on special teams that helped seal the win.

items.title: Cam Little is AFC special teams player of the week for second week in a row
items.text: Jaguars kicker Cam Little turned in another strong game against the Titans last Sunday.

items.title: Colts CB Justin Walley named the AFC defensive player of the week
items.text: The Colts ended a five-game losing streak with last Sunday's win over the Dolphins and a defensive touchdown played a big role in the 24-22 win.

items.title: Jaelan Phillips wins first NFC defensive player of the week award
items.text: The Panthers moved into sole possession of first place in the NFC South with their victory over the Saints on Sunday.

items.title: Jahmyr Gibbs wins second NFC offensive player of the week award of the season
items.text: Lions running back Jahmyr Gibbs continued his terrific 2026 season in Sunday's win over the Patriots in Munich.

items.title: Joe Burrow named AFC offensive player of the week for second time this season
items.text: Bengals quarterback Joe Burrow is the betting favorite to be the NFL MVP this season and games like the one he had last Sunday are the reason why he's in that spot.

items.title: Geno Smith will be limited in Wednesday's practice
items.text: Jets quarterback Geno Smith avoided a major ankle injury in last Sunday's loss to the Bills, but his Week 11 status remains uncertain.

items.title: Ben Johnson sees Bears' 4.2 yards per carry average as "a deceiving statistic"
items.text: League wide, NFL teams average 4.2 yards per rushing attempt.

items.title: 49ers likely won't cut Brandon Aiyuk until they have to
items.text: With a roster exemption that lasts until November 24 and with no requirement to pay him a penny until the exemption expires, the 49ers have shown no inclination to release receiver Brandon Aiyuk until they absolutely have to.

items.title: Vikings WR Jauan Jennings prepare to face his former team
items.text: Sunday night's game in Mexico City between the Vikings and 49ers has multiple interesting subplots.

items.title: Report: Jaguars C Robert Hainsey week-to-week with knee injury
items.text: Jaguars center Robert Hainsey left last Sunday's win over the Titans with a knee injury and it looks like he will need some more time to recover.

items.title: Report: Mike Pettine takes over as Cowboys' defensive play-caller
items.text: Christian Parker will remain the defensive coordinator.
